prediction_text: The husband is ALIVE and in good case: his significator, the Sun, is in his hayz and free from all affliction — no testimony of death or shipwreck touches him. He is still abroad at sea on his voyage, in safety. He shall return home again; but the timing signs in the figure are partly garbled in the printing, so I give the return only at month-scale (within the following months, when the Mars–Saturn ill aspect has passed and the Moon's course completes). 推测： the heavier affliction in this figure falls on the wife herself (Saturn, lord of her 6th, retrograde; Mars and Saturn moving to an ill aspect about the Moon's place): her own sickness is the more dangerous matter, and she may relapse gravely before or about the time of his return.
basis: 卡面未标注 tradition 字段，按题面体裁自决（Lilly horary，第七宫海上丈夫章法）。systems_used: horary。已载面：夫生死（主问）、何地、何时归。断项过闸：夫存且安←夫象征太阳得其位（hayz）且全然无克；归期←原文位置多处 OCR 残损，无完整成相度数可凭，只给月尺度窗口、不落单日（残损已注明并降置信）；妻身之险一条只有指代（六宫主土星逆行）与动向（火土趋凶相）两指针中的象意一路较全，按推测降格交付。对象核：夫之断语主语对回丈夫本人；妻之断语另栏、未与夫之生死合并。
